question: On all saved 27baa 0/2/5bp native raw-share accounts, which actual holding components explain SOXX-relative losing versus winning 126-session windows?
prices_and_cash: Use saved raw point prices, splits, dividends, actual own holdings/cash/receivable and Tiered fees. Verify each candidate daily arithmetic return against native authority at 1e-9 and benchmark returns against saved raw SOXX book. No policy replay or new market data.
decomposition: For each of four actual holding segments, with weights relative to the same day's pretrade NAV, cash opportunity is -(1-w_SOXL-w_SOXX)*SOXX segment total return; SOXL selection is w_SOXL*(SOXL segment total return-SOXX segment total return). Direct fees are saved negative fee/pretradeNAV. Residual is actual strategy minus benchmark daily arithmetic return minus these components, including intraday benchmark compounding and accounting differences. Multiply each arithmetic component by the same exact per-day log-difference conversion scalar, retaining the residual. No component alone is a tradable counterfactual.
population: All944 saved sessions, both partial end years, both complete years, all16 quarters and all819 contiguous126-session windows at each cost; no selected winning or losing interval exclusion.
report: cash-negative, selection-negative, both-negative counts among losing and winning windows
mean cash, selection, fee, residual log components in both window groups
stop: Any source hash, calendar, share/cash/fee, daily arithmetic return, daily log excess, period/window count or decomposed identity mismatch stops. No future outcome-selected switch, threshold, fit, new account, or promotion.
